info.name: REM Real Estate Management API
info.description:
Complete collection for testing REM microservices through API Gateway

**Base URL**: {{base_url}} (http://localhost:8081)

**Services**:
- Auth & Identity Service: Authentication, users, profiles
- Person Service: Individuals, companies, contacts
- Address Service: Property addresses
- Property Service: Properties, amenities, property management

**Test Users** (from seed data):
- juan.perez@example.com / password
- maria.gonzalez@example.com / password
- admin@acmecorp.com / password (company)

**Usage**:
1. Run authentication requests to get tokens
2. Use {{access_token}} in subsequent requests
3. Test CRUD operations on persons, addresses, properties, and amenities

item.name: 🔐 Authentication & Users
item.description: Authentication, user management, and profile operations

request.description:
Register a new user with optional person data. Creates both user account and associated person record via microservices communication.

Payload structure:
- email: User email (required)
- password: User password (required) 
- person: Person data (optional)
  - type: 'individual' or 'company'
  - individual: Individual person data (when type=individual)
    - first_name, last_name, dni, sexo
  - address: Address data (optional)
    - street, number, city, state, zip, country

Response includes user_id and person_id for successful registrations.
